```json
{"version":1,"taskId":"f3431270-3cba-49ff-9975-5485bdf17a15","commandId":"check-5","operation":"run","headSha":"251d640f4cf839d94618ec8f2021654da077f43e","command":"TMP=$(mktemp); npx vitest run > \"$TMP\" 2>&1; CODE=$?; grep -E 'Test Files|Tests ' \"$TMP\"; echo \"vitest exit=$CODE\"; rm -f \"$TMP\"; exit $CODE","timeoutSeconds":900}
```
